title: 阳光棱边小停顿
description: 油画小品中，窗光沿外棱落下，成人在大点上低位停顿。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional adult pausing at a low rounded arete in a sunlit climbing gym. Both shoes press generous footholds close to continuous crash mats, and the hands rest on broad blue holds across the two wall faces. The climber calmly studies a nearby next hold without climbing high or leaning dramatically away. Use an oblique medium-wide view that includes the whole opaque-clothed adult, warm window shadows, and an empty padded landing. Paint visible impasto, ochre light, and muted indigo wall planes rather than photographic detail. Keep adult proportions credible. Include no text, logos, jumping, high exposure, or people below.
